mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_token (user_id, token, expire_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{token}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id AS userId, t.token, t.expire_time AS expireTime, u.username, u.role FROM t_token t JOIN t_users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.token = #{token} AND t.expire_time > NOW() LIMIT 1
